title: Kerala fish curry with coconut and tomatoes
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli and soften in the oil for 6 minutes, then toast the turmeric and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook down for 5 minutes, then pour in the coconut milk and 100 ml water.
Add the fish pieces and spinach and simmer gently, covered, for 8 minutes.
Season with salt and lime juice and serve with coriander and rice.
